as_told.title: FBI document on the UFO-nuclear connection

plain: In 1949, according to Michels, a memo, now public, went to J. Edgar Hoover, director of the FBI, the US federal police, reporting "flying discs, flying saucers, and balls of fire" that were "considered Top Secret by Intelligence Officers of both the Army and Air Force," in connection with the Los Alamos nuclear weapons laboratory in New Mexico. Michels raises it as early evidence that UFOs were drawn to nuclear sites, and mentions it again in a later episode only as an FBI document on the link between UFOs and nuclear weapons.
